## Analyse GO annotation enrichment of hierarchical clustering

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
```

1.  Load Data

```{r}
gene_column <- "PG.Genes"
cluster_column <- "Cluster"

Int <- read.delim("Int_inclTtests_forPython_revision_m741.txt",sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
Int <- Int[-c(1, 2), ]

Cluster <- read.delim("Int_clusterResults_forPathway.txt",sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
Cluster <- Cluster[-1, ]

kegg_organism <- "hsa"
```

2.  Background

```{r}
background_symbols <- Int %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(gene_column)) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    dplyr::all_of(gene_column),
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(dplyr::all_of(gene_column)) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  trimws() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  unique()

background_mapping <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  background_symbols,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  drop = TRUE
)

background_entrez <- unique(background_mapping$ENTREZID)
```

```{r}
cluster_long <- Cluster %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(cluster_column),
    dplyr::all_of(gene_column)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    dplyr::all_of(gene_column),
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_symbol = trimws(
      as.character(.data[[gene_column]])
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data[[cluster_column]],
    gene_symbol
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_long %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data[[cluster_column]],
    name = "number_of_genes"
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_gene_mapping <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  unique(cluster_long$gene_symbol),
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  drop = TRUE
)

cluster_entrez_table <- cluster_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster_gene_mapping,
    by = c("gene_symbol" = "SYMBOL")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENTREZID %in% background_entrez) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data[[cluster_column]],
    ENTREZID
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_entrez_table %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data[[cluster_column]],
    name = "mapped_entrez_ids"
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_gene_lists <- split(
  cluster_entrez_table$ENTREZID,
  cluster_entrez_table[[cluster_column]]
)

cluster_gene_lists <- lapply(
  cluster_gene_lists,
  unique
)
```

```{r}
go_bp_compare <- clusterProfiler::compareCluster(
  geneCluster   = cluster_gene_lists,
  fun           = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  universe      = background_entrez,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.20,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  readable      = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
go_cc_compare <- clusterProfiler::compareCluster(
  geneCluster   = cluster_gene_lists,
  fun           = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "CC",
  universe      = background_entrez,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.20,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  readable      = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
go_bp_plot_data <- as.data.frame(go_bp_compare)

go_bp_plot_data <- go_bp_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

go_bp_selected_terms <- go_bp_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(
    order_by = p.adjust,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Description) %>%
  unique()

go_bp_plot_data_selected <- go_bp_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Description %in% go_bp_selected_terms)

go_bp_plot_data_selected <- go_bp_plot_data_selected %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    negLog10Padj = -log10(p.adjust)
  )

go_bp_plot_data_selected$Cluster <- factor(
  go_bp_plot_data_selected$Cluster,
  levels = c(
    "Cluster -1390",
    "Cluster -1388",
    "Cluster -1382",
    "Cluster -1386",
    "Cluster -1374"
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(viridis)

go_bp_cluster_dotplot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  go_bp_plot_data_selected,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Description,
    size = Count,
    color = negLog10Padj
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = expression(-log[10]("adj. p"))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "GO Biological Process enrichment",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Protein count",
    color = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
  )

go_bp_cluster_dotplot
```

```{r}
go_cc_plot_data <- as.data.frame(go_cc_compare)

go_cc_plot_data <- go_cc_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

go_cc_selected_terms <- go_cc_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(
    order_by = p.adjust,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Description) %>%
  unique()

go_cc_plot_data_selected <- go_cc_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Description %in% go_cc_selected_terms)

go_cc_plot_data_selected <- go_cc_plot_data_selected %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    negLog10Padj = -log10(p.adjust)
  )

go_cc_plot_data_selected$Cluster <- factor(
  go_cc_plot_data_selected$Cluster,
  levels = c(
    "Cluster -1390",
    "Cluster -1388",
    "Cluster -1382",
    "Cluster -1386",
    "Cluster -1374"
  )
)
```

```{r}
go_cc_cluster_dotplot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  go_cc_plot_data_selected,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Description,
    size = Count,
    color = negLog10Padj
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    option = "magma",
    name = expression(-log[10]("adj. p"))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "GO Cellular Component enrichment",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Protein count"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
  )

go_cc_cluster_dotplot
```

```{r}
library(svglite)

ggsave(
  filename = "GO_BP_cluster_dotplot.svg",
  plot = go_bp_cluster_dotplot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "GO_CC_cluster_dotplot.svg",
  plot = go_cc_cluster_dotplot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
```
